[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Edit distance** [LC 72 · Edit Distance](https://leetcode.com/problems/edit-distance/){difficulty="Medium"}

Gluing the strings at the left and replacing every mismatch charges 4 for `abcd` into `bcd`. Deleting the leading `a` charges 1, and then every letter matches. The gap can sit anywhere, so the state is the pair of prefixes, and the last column of the alignment is the only decision.
